import json,time
def external_request(client,ids,expected,key,observed):
    body=json.dumps({"token_ids":ids,"return_token_ids":True,"stream":True,
      "sampling_params":{"max_tokens":len(expected),"temperature":0.0,
                         "ignore_eos":True,"detokenize":False}},separators=(",",":")).encode()
    headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","Authorization":"Bearer "+key}
    start=time.monotonic_ns();observed.update(start_ns=start)
    client.request("POST","/inference/v1/generate",body,headers)
    response=client.getresponse()
    assert response.status==200,(response.status,response.read().decode())
    assert "text/event-stream" in response.getheader("Content-Type","")
    pending=b"";actual=[];arrivals=[];frames=[];done=False;prompt=None;finish=None
    observed.update(tokens=actual,arrival_ns=arrivals,frames=frames)
    while not done:
        data=response.read1(4096); arrived=time.monotonic_ns()
        assert data,"stream ended without DONE"
        pending+=data;observed["received_bytes"]=observed.get("received_bytes",0)+len(data)
        while b"\n\n" in pending:
            frame,pending=pending.split(b"\n\n",1)
            payload=b"\n".join(line[6:] for line in frame.splitlines() if line.startswith(b"data: "))
            if not payload: continue
            if payload==b"[DONE]": done=True;continue
            obj=json.loads(payload)
            if "prompt_token_ids" in obj: prompt=obj["prompt_token_ids"]
            for choice in obj["choices"]:
                assert choice["index"]==0,choice
                tokens=choice.get("token_ids") or []
                assert all(type(t)==int and 0<=t<151936 for t in tokens),tokens
                actual.extend(tokens);arrivals.extend([arrived]*len(tokens))
                if choice.get("finish_reason") is not None: finish=choice["finish_reason"]
            frames.append({"arrival_ns":arrived,"response":obj})
    tail=response.read(); assert not pending.strip() and not tail.strip(),(pending,tail)
    assert prompt==ids,(prompt,ids)
    assert len(actual)==len(expected),(actual,expected)
    assert finish=="length",finish
    return {"start_ns":start,"arrival_ns":arrivals,"tokens":actual,"exact_reference":actual==expected,
      "first_mismatch":next((i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(actual,expected)) if a!=b),None),
      "ttft_ms":(arrivals[0]-start)/1e6,"latency_ms":(arrivals[-1]-start)/1e6,
      "tpot_ms":(arrivals[-1]-arrivals[0])/(len(expected)-1)/1e6 if len(expected)>1 else None,
      "frames":frames}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
"""Bootstrap upstream vLLM graphs; native GPU owns online request execution."""
import argparse,ctypes,json,math,os,sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
OriginalGraph=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph
class KeptGraph(OriginalGraph):
    def __new__(cls,keep_graph=False):return super().__new__(cls,True)
    def __init__(self,keep_graph=False):super().__init__(True)
torch.cuda.CUDAGraph=KeptGraph
from vllm import LLM
from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.cudagraph_utils import ModelCudaGraphManager,BatchExecutionDescriptor
from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel import gumbel_sample

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("model");ap.add_argument("seconds",type=int,nargs="?",default=60)
    ap.add_argument("--trace-output");ap.add_argument("--trace-requests",type=int,default=0)
    args=ap.parse_args()
    root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    entry=Path(sys.argv[0]).absolute()
    library=entry.with_suffix(".so") if entry.name.startswith("vllm_mixed") and entry.suffix!=".py" else root/"build/vllm_mixed_uring_loop.so"
    trace_path=Path(args.trace_output).resolve() if args.trace_output else None
    os.chdir(root)
    lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(library),mode=os.RTLD_LOCAL|os.RTLD_DEEPBIND)
    lib.max_tokens.restype=ctypes.c_uint;lib.max_requests.restype=ctypes.c_uint
    limit=lib.max_tokens();banks=lib.max_requests()
    assert os.environ.get("VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING")=="0","in-process bootstrap required for graph ownership"
    # The shared protocol owns eight slots, each at most prompt+output tokens.
    # Size their cache from the actual loaded upstream layer specs, including
    # the allocator's null block, before its ordinary initialization/profile.
    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu_worker import Worker
    from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import FullAttentionSpec
    original_memory=Worker.determine_available_memory
    def queue_memory(worker):
        specs=worker.get_kv_cache_spec()
        assert specs and all(type(spec) is FullAttentionSpec for spec in specs.values()),"full-attention cache required"
        block_sizes={spec.block_size for spec in specs.values()}
        assert len(block_sizes)==1,"uniform cache group required"
        needed_blocks=1+banks*math.ceil(2*limit/next(iter(block_sizes)))
        cache_bytes=needed_blocks*sum(spec.page_size_bytes for spec in specs.values())
        worker.cache_config.kv_cache_memory_bytes=cache_bytes
        print(json.dumps(dict(event="vllm_protocol_cache",context_tokens=2*limit,
            banks=banks,needed_blocks=needed_blocks,cache_bytes=cache_bytes,
            specs={name:dict(block_size=spec.block_size,page_size_bytes=spec.page_size_bytes)
                   for name,spec in specs.items()})),flush=True)
        return original_memory(worker)
    Worker.determine_available_memory=queue_memory
    try:
        llm=LLM(model=args.model,dtype="half",max_model_len=2*limit)
    finally:
        Worker.determine_available_memory=original_memory
    runner=llm.llm_engine.model_executor.driver_worker.worker.model_runner
    bt=runner.block_tables;buf=runner.input_buffers;config=runner.model_config.hf_config
    assert bt.num_kv_cache_groups==1 and bt.cp_size==1 and not runner.use_aux_hidden_state_outputs
    size=limit*banks+1;graphs={};managers=[]
    mapping=torch.arange(banks,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda")
    temperatures=torch.zeros(banks,dtype=torch.float32,device="cuda")
    seeds=torch.zeros(banks,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda")
    stream=torch.cuda.Stream()
    with torch.inference_mode():
        manager=ModelCudaGraphManager(runner.vllm_config,runner.device,
            CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE,decode_query_len=1)
        manager._capture_descs={CUDAGraphMode.FULL:[
            BatchExecutionDescriptor(cg_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL,
                num_tokens=count,num_reqs=min(count,banks))
            for count in range(size-1,0,-1)]}
        manager.capture(runner.model,runner.model_state,buf,runner.intermediate_tensors,
            bt,runner.attn_groups,runner.kv_cache_config,progress_bar_desc="Packed mixed")
        managers.append(manager)
        for count in range(1,size):
            padded_reqs=min(count,banks)
            desc=next(d for d in manager.graphs if d.num_tokens==count)
            def sample():
                indices=buf.query_start_loc[1:padded_reqs+1].to(torch.int64)-1
                hidden=manager.hidden_states[indices]
                logits=runner.get_model().compute_logits(hidden)
                return gumbel_sample(logits,mapping[:padded_reqs],temperatures,seeds,
                    buf.positions[indices],apply_temperature=False,is_drafting=False)
            stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
            with torch.cuda.stream(stream):warm=sample()
            stream.synchronize()
            head=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(keep_graph=True)
            with torch.cuda.graph(head,stream=stream,pool=manager.pool):output=sample()
            stream.synchronize()
            graphs[count]=(manager.graphs[desc],head,output)
            if count%64==0:print(f"captured packed mixed input tokens1..{count}/{size-1}",flush=True)
    pool=llm.llm_engine.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.kv_cache_manager.block_pool
    blocks_per_request=math.ceil(2*limit/bt.block_sizes[0])
    blocks=pool.get_new_blocks(banks*blocks_per_request)
    try:
        expansion=bt.blocks_per_kv_block[0]
        rows=[[block.block_id*expansion+k
               for block in blocks[i*blocks_per_request:(i+1)*blocks_per_request]
               for k in range(expansion)] for i in range(banks)]
        pages=torch.tensor(rows,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda")
        pointer_values=[buf.input_ids.data_ptr(),buf.positions.data_ptr(),buf.seq_lens.data_ptr(),
            buf.query_start_loc.data_ptr(),buf.is_padding.data_ptr(),bt.slot_mappings[0].data_ptr(),
            bt.input_block_tables[0].data_ptr(),pages.data_ptr()]
        emit=dict(event="vllm_bootstrap",model=args.model,block_sizes=bt.block_sizes,
            kernel_block_sizes=bt.kernel_block_sizes,pages=rows,graph_count=len(graphs),
            captured_input_tokens=list(range(1,size)),graph_request_padding="min(input_tokens,banks)",capture="upstream mixed descriptor; no attention support override")
        print(json.dumps(emit),flush=True)
        ptr=ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulonglong)
        lib.serve.argtypes=[ptr,ptr,ptr,ptr]+[ctypes.c_uint]*8+[ctypes.c_char_p]
        lib.serve.restype=ctypes.c_int
        bodies=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(0,*(graphs[i][0].raw_cuda_graph() for i in range(1,size)))
        head_raw=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(0,*(graphs[i][1].raw_cuda_graph() for i in range(1,size)))
        outputs=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*size)(0,*(graphs[i][2].data_ptr() for i in range(1,size)))
        pointers=(ctypes.c_ulonglong*8)(*pointer_values)
        status=lib.serve(bodies,head_raw,outputs,pointers,bt.input_block_tables[0].stride(0),
            bt.kernel_block_sizes[0],pages.shape[1],config.vocab_size,config.num_hidden_layers,
            config.hidden_size,args.seconds,args.trace_requests,str(trace_path).encode() if trace_path else None)
        if status:raise RuntimeError(f"native serve failed: {status}")
        if trace_path:
            sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
            from mixed_replay import audit
            audit(trace_path,runner,buf,bt,graphs,pages,rows,config,banks,limit)
    finally:
        torch.cuda.synchronize();pool.free_blocks(blocks)

if __name__=="__main__":main()

"""Independent request-history reconstruction for upstream packed mixed graphs."""
import json
import numpy as np
import torch
from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.input_batch import InputBatch
from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.attn_utils import build_slot_mappings_by_layer
from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.gumbel import gumbel_sample

@torch.inference_mode()
def audit(trace_path,runner,buf,bt,graphs,pages,rows,config,banks,limit):
    events=[json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.open()]
    assert events[-1]["event"]=="terminal" and events[-1]["overflows"]==0
    mapping=torch.arange(banks,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda")
    temperatures=torch.zeros(banks,dtype=torch.float32,device="cuda")
    seeds=torch.zeros(banks,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda")
    for fresh in [False,True]:
        # All caches belong to this one post-serving model bootstrap. Reset
        # values without changing tensor addresses used by captured graphs.
        for cache in runner.kv_caches:cache.zero_()
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        requests={};owners={};released=set();checked=0;rounds=0;mixed_rounds=0
        fresh_log=trace_path.with_suffix(trace_path.suffix+".fresh_metadata.jsonl")
        log=fresh_log.open("w") if fresh else None
        with torch.inference_mode():
            try:
                for e in events:
                    if e["event"]=="admission":
                        rid=e["id"];physical=rid%banks
                        assert physical not in owners
                        owners[physical]=rid
                        bad=not(1<=e["query"]<=limit and 1<=e["gen"]<=limit) or any(x>=config.vocab_size for x in e["input_ids"])
                        assert bool(e["bad"])==bad
                        requests[rid]=dict(prompt=e["input_ids"],gen=e["gen"],bad=bad,client_ns=e["client_ns"],tokens=[])
                    elif e["event"]=="compute":
                        selected=e["request_ids"];batch=len(selected)
                        assert batch==e["batch"] and len(set(selected))==batch
                        packed=[];positions=[];slots=[];starts=[0];seqs=[];qlens=[];prefilling=[];prompts=[];computed=[]
                        for row,rid in enumerate(selected):
                            req=requests[rid];history=req["tokens"];prompt=req["prompt"];physical=rid%banks
                            assert owners[physical]==rid and rid not in released and not req["bad"]
                            assert len(history)<req["gen"]
                            if history:
                                values=[history[-1]];pos=[len(prompt)+len(history)-1];seq=pos[0]+1
                            else:values=prompt;pos=list(range(len(prompt)));seq=len(prompt)
                            packed+=values;positions+=pos;starts.append(len(packed))
                            slots+=[rows[physical][position//bt.kernel_block_sizes[0]]*bt.kernel_block_sizes[0]+position%bt.kernel_block_sizes[0] for position in pos]
                            seqs.append(seq);qlens.append(len(values));prefilling.append(not history);prompts.append(len(prompt));computed.append(seq-len(values))
                        count=len(packed);padded=min(count,banks)
                        assert count==e["input_tokens"] and batch<=padded
                        expected_query=max((len(requests[rid]["prompt"]) for rid in selected if not requests[rid]["tokens"]),default=0)
                        assert expected_query==e["query"]
                        is_mixed=any(prefilling) and not all(prefilling)
                        mixed_rounds+=is_mixed;rounds+=1
                        trailing=padded-batch
                        seqs+=[0]*trailing;qlens+=[0]*trailing;prefilling+=[False]*trailing;prompts+=[0]*trailing;computed+=[0]*trailing
                        starts+=[count]*trailing
                        if fresh:
                            ib=InputBatch.make_dummy(padded,count,buf,max_query_len=count)
                            ib.num_scheduled_tokens=np.array(qlens,dtype=np.int32)
                            ib.query_start_loc_np=np.array(starts,dtype=np.int32)
                            ib.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=torch.tensor(seqs,dtype=torch.int32,device="cpu")
                            ib.num_computed_tokens_np=np.array(computed,dtype=np.int32)
                            ib.prefill_len_np=np.array(prompts,dtype=np.int32)
                            ib.num_computed_prefill_tokens_np=np.array([0 if prefilling[i] else prompts[i] for i in range(padded)],dtype=np.int32)
                            ib.is_prefilling_np=np.array(prefilling,dtype=np.bool_)
                            ib.has_prefill=bool(any(prefilling));ib.decode_graph_eligible=not ib.has_prefill
                            ib.max_query_len=max(qlens)
                        buf.input_ids[:count].copy_(torch.tensor(packed,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda"))
                        buf.positions[:count].copy_(torch.tensor(positions,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda"))
                        buf.seq_lens[:padded].copy_(torch.tensor(seqs,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda"))
                        buf.query_start_loc[:padded+1].copy_(torch.tensor(starts,dtype=torch.int32,device="cuda"))
                        buf.is_padding[:count].fill_(False)
                        bt.slot_mappings[0,:count].copy_(torch.tensor(slots,dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda"))
                        bt.input_block_tables[0][:padded].zero_()
                        for row,rid in enumerate(selected):
                            bt.input_block_tables[0][row,:pages.shape[1]].copy_(pages[rid%banks])
                        if fresh:
                            sm=bt.slot_mappings[:,:count]
                            metadata=runner.model_state.prepare_attn(ib,CUDAGraphMode.NONE,
                                tuple(table[:padded] for table in bt.input_block_tables),sm,
                                runner.attn_groups,runner.kv_cache_config,for_capture=False)
                            with set_forward_context(metadata,runner.vllm_config,num_tokens=count,
                                cudagraph_runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.NONE,
                                slot_mapping=build_slot_mappings_by_layer(sm,runner.kv_cache_config),
                                is_padding=buf.is_padding[:count]):
                                hidden=runner.model(input_ids=buf.input_ids[:count],
                                    positions=buf.positions[:count],intermediate_tensors=None,
                                    **runner.model_state.prepare_dummy_inputs(padded,count))
                            indices=torch.tensor([x-1 for x in starts[1:]],dtype=torch.int64,device="cuda")
                            logits=runner.get_model().compute_logits(hidden[indices])
                            output=gumbel_sample(logits,mapping[:padded],temperatures,seeds,
                                buf.positions[indices],apply_temperature=False,is_drafting=False)
                        else:
                            body,head,output=graphs[count];body.replay();head.replay()
                        actual=output.cpu().tolist()[:batch]
                        assert actual==e["tokens"],dict(fresh=fresh,event=e,expected=actual)
                        for rid,token in zip(selected,actual):requests[rid]["tokens"].append(token)
                        checked+=batch
                        if log:log.write(json.dumps(dict(event="fresh_metadata_compute",round=rounds,batch=batch,padded_requests=padded,input_tokens=count,query_lengths=qlens,sequence_lengths=seqs,mixed=is_mixed,request_ids=selected,tokens=actual,exact=True))+"\n")
                    elif e["event"]=="release":
                        selected=e["request_ids"]
                        assert selected==list(range(len(released),len(released)+len(selected)))
                        for rid in selected:
                            req=requests[rid]
                            assert req["bad"] or len(req["tokens"])==req["gen"]
                            assert rid not in released and owners.pop(rid%banks)==rid
                            released.add(rid)
                assert not owners and released==set(requests)
                if not fresh:
                    with trace_path.with_suffix(trace_path.suffix+".references.jsonl").open("w") as out:
                        for rid,req in requests.items():out.write(json.dumps(dict(id=rid,**req))+"\n")
                summary=dict(event="fresh_metadata_verified" if fresh else "vllm_reference_replay",requests=len(requests),checked_tokens=checked,rounds=rounds,mixed_rounds=mixed_rounds,exact=True)
                if log:log.write(json.dumps(summary)+"\n")
                print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
            finally:
                if log:log.close()

# BPFusion build: eBPF objects and userspace tools.
#
#   make            # build everything into build/
#   make probes     # only the eBPF objects
#   make run-probe  # build + run the ingress-wake probe
#
# Requires: clang, libbpf, libelf, zlib, libcuda/nvcc for the executor.

BUILD    := build
override CPPFLAGS += -DBF_BUILD_DIR='"$(abspath $(BUILD))"'
ARCH     := $(shell uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/x86/;s/aarch64/arm64/')
BPF_CFLAGS := -O2 -g -target bpf -mcpu=v3 -D__TARGET_ARCH_$(ARCH) \
              -I/usr/include/$(shell uname -m)-linux-gnu -Ibpf/include \
              -Wall -Werror -Wno-missing-declarations -Wno-unused-value
CC       ?= cc
CFLAGS   ?= -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter
LDLIBS   := -lbpf -lelf -lz -lpthread

BPF_SRCS := $(filter-out bpf/uring_loop.bpf.c,$(wildcard bpf/*.bpf.c))
BPF_OBJS := $(patsubst bpf/%.bpf.c,$(BUILD)/%.bpf.o,$(BPF_SRCS))
TOOLS    := $(BUILD)/wake_probe $(BUILD)/client $(BUILD)/echo_udp \
            $(BUILD)/bpfusion_load $(BUILD)/perfcount

.PHONY: all probes tools executor clean run-probe run-executor

CUDA_HOME ?= /usr/local/cuda
NVCC      ?= $(CUDA_HOME)/bin/nvcc
SM_ARCH   ?= sm_120
KERNEL_UAPI := $(firstword $(wildcard /lib/modules/$(shell uname -r)/build/include/uapi /usr/src/linux-headers-$(shell uname -r)/include/uapi))

all: probes tools executor

probes: $(BPF_OBJS)

tools: $(TOOLS)

executor: $(BUILD)/executor

$(BUILD)/%.bpf.o: bpf/%.bpf.c bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h bpf/include/bpfusion_admission.h | $(BUILD)
	clang $(CPPFLAGS) $(BPF_CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BUILD)/wake_probe: tools/wake_probe/main.c | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

$(BUILD)/client: tools/client.c bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -Ibpf/include $< -o $@

$(BUILD)/echo_udp: tools/echo_udp.c | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@
$(BUILD)/bpfusion_load: tools/bpfusion_load.c bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CPPFLAGS) $(CFLAGS) -Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

$(BUILD)/perfcount: tools/perfcount.c | $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $< -o $@

$(BUILD)/executor: executor/executor.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h \
                   executor/cuda_timer.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) $(CPPFLAGS) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -Iexecutor -Ibpf/include \
		$< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)


run-executor: executor
	./$(BUILD)/executor $${N:-20000} $${WORK:-4} $${BATCH:-1}

$(BUILD):
	mkdir -p $(BUILD)

run-probe: all
	sudo ./$(BUILD)/wake_probe $(BUILD)/wake_probe.bpf.o 20000 50 1
	sudo ./$(BUILD)/wake_probe $(BUILD)/wake_probe.bpf.o 20000 50 0

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)

.PHONY: qwen
qwen: $(BUILD)/qwen

$(BUILD)/qwen: executor/qwen.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) $(CPPFLAGS) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# Same device kernel, host dispatch once per request: a mechanism control.
.PHONY: qwen-control
qwen-control: $(BUILD)/qwen_host_launch

$(BUILD)/qwen_host_launch: executor/qwen.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) $(CPPFLAGS) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_HOST_LAUNCH -Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# Device-launched HF graphs; Python captures only during bootstrap.
.PHONY: qwen-graph
qwen-graph: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) $(CPPFLAGS) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# GPU-owned stock io_uring TCP; uses the same HF graph computation.
.PHONY: qwen-graph-uring
qwen-graph-uring: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu executor/io_uring_tcp.h bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) $(CPPFLAGS) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_URING_NETWORK -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# Same concurrent GPU graph banks; host resumes once per retired request.
.PHONY: qwen-graph-control
qwen-graph-control: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) $(CPPFLAGS) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_HOST_LAUNCH -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_host_launch $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network_wait $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_uring: executor/qwen_graph.py | $(BUILD)
	ln -sf $(abspath executor/qwen_graph.py) $@

# Same resident GPU graphs with an epoll userspace TCP/HTTP control.
.PHONY: qwen-graph-user-network
qwen-graph-user-network: $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network.so $(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network

$(BUILD)/qwen_graph_user_network.so: executor/qwen_graph.cu executor/userspace_tcp.h bpf/include/bpfusion_queue.h | $(BUILD)
	$(NVCC) $(CPPFLAGS) -O3 -std=c++17 -arch=$(SM_ARCH) -DBF_USER_NETWORK -rdc=true -shared -Xcompiler=-fPIC \
		-Ibpf/include $< -o $@ $(LDLIBS)

# CPU-efficient network control; model graphs and device dispatcher are unchanged.
